title: battery kernel options show the battery on a laptop

clauses.text: after the kernel with the battery options is installed, a laptop lists its battery in the power supply folder

steps.do: On the laptop, open the Terminal tile and run: ls /sys/class/power_supply
steps.expect: A BAT0 entry is listed (and AC for the adapter) on a laptop with a battery. Without the battery options only the adapter is listed.
